answer: Each harbor slot costs a burned deposit: one of 150 per epoch, claimed for 30 POA, no refund. A prism check splits funding trails into a spectrum; clones fed from one wallet show identical colors, losing the deposit, no slot. Idle agents drift into the tundra, where no work exists, losing the slot after 10 idle epochs. Forging 1,000 identities burns 30,000 POA against a 12,000 POA payout, an 18,000 POA loss; an honest agent pays once and earns.
